standard.summary: 训练数据集中图说文件的扩展名。训练器会在每张图像同目录查找同名的图说文件。
standard.effect: .txt = 普通文本图说（每行一个 tag 或自然语言描述）；.caption = ComfyUI 常用格式（功能相同）。
standard.whenToUse: 根据图说文件的实际格式设置。大多数工具（WD tagger、BLIP等）输出 .txt 格式。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要修改，保持与图说文件的实际扩展名一致即可。

standard_en.summary: The extension of the caption files in the training dataset. The trainer looks for a same-named caption file beside each image.
standard_en.effect: .txt = plain-text captions (one tag per line, or a natural-language description); .caption = the format ComfyUI commonly uses (functionally identical).
standard_en.whenToUse: Set it to whatever your caption files actually use. Most tools (WD tagger, BLIP and so on) write .txt.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No change is needed -- just keep it matching the real extension of the caption files.

advanced.principle: 训练器遍历数据集目录时，对每张图像寻找同名 + 指定扩展名的文件作为其图说。若找不到，使用空图说或触发词（取决于其他设置）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 同一目录下混用 .txt 和 .caption 时，只会识别 caption_extension 指定的格式，另一种被忽略。

advanced_en.principle: When traversing the dataset directory, the trainer looks for a file with the same name plus the given extension as each image's caption. If none is found, an empty caption or trigger word is used (depending on other settings).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: When .txt and .caption are mixed in one directory, only the format named by caption_extension is recognized and the other is ignored.
